G2900.def:
κραταιός, -ά, -όν 
(κράτος), (in cl. poët, form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק and cognates ;] 
strong, mighty: 1 Pierre 5:6.†

G2901.def:
κραταιόω, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;] 
to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: Luc 2:40, 1 Corinthiens 16:13; πνεύματι, Luc 1:80; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, Éphésiens 3:16.†

G2902.def:
κρατέω, -ῶ 
(κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק hi., also for אָחַז, etc. ;] 
__1. to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: Esther 1:1, I Esther 4:38, Wis.14:19, al.). 
__2. to get possession of, obtain, take hold of (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive of thing(s) (M, Pr., 65), Actes 27:13; τ. χειρός, Matthieu 9:25, Marc 1:31 5:41 9:27, Luc 8:54; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 12:11; with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 14:3 18:28 21:46 22:6 26:4, 48 ff., Marc 3:21 6:17 12:12 14:1, 44 ff, Actes 3:11 24:6, Apocalypse 20:2 (cf. 2 Rois 6:6). 
__3. to hold, hold fast (Æsch., Polyb., al.): with accusative of thing(s), ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, Apocalypse 2:1. Metaphorical: with accusative of person(s), pass., Actes 2:24; with accusative of thing(s), Apocalypse 2:13, 25 3:11; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), Colossiens 2:19; τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, Marc 7:3-4, 8 9:10, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:15, Apocalypse 2:14-15; with genitive of thing(s), Hébreux 4:14 6:18; of sins, to retain, Jean 20:23; of re­straint, before ἵνα μή, Apocalypse 7:1; pass., before τοῦ μή, Luc 24:16.†

G2903.def:
κράτιστος, -η, -ον 
superl, of κρατύς (Hom.), 
__1. strongest, mightiest (Hom.). 
__2. noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), most excellent (find., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), Luc 1:3, Actes 23:26 24:3 26:25.†

G2904.def:
κράτος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in LXX chiefly for עֹז, Job 12:16, Psaumes 90:11 al. ;] 
__1. strength, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength. 
__2. power, might: Hébreux 2:14; τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, Éphésiens 1:19 6:10 (Ésaïe 40:26, Da TH Daniel 4:27); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, Colossiens 1:11; κατὰ κράτος, mightily, Actes 19:20; a mighty deed, an act of power, Luc 1:51; in doxologies, 1 Timothée 6:16, 1 Pierre 4:11 5:11, Ju 25, Apocalypse 1:6 5:13.†

G2905.def:
κραυγάζω (κραυγή) 
[in LXX: Esther 3:13 (רוּעַ hi.)* ;] = κράζω 
__1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc. 
__2. Of men, to cry out, shout: Matthieu 12:19, Jean 12:13 19:15 Actes 22:23; before λέγων, Jean 18:40 19:6, 12; καὶ λέγων, Luc 4:41 (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Jean 11:43 (cf. Abbott, JV, 269 f.).†

G2906.def:
κραυγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc. ;] 
crying, outcry, clamour: Matthieu 25:6, Luc 1:42, Actes 23:9, Éphésiens 4:31, Hébreux 5:7, Apocalypse 21:4.†

G2907.def:
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα 
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;] 
flesh, meat: Romains 14:21, 1 Corinthiens 8:13.†

G2910.def:
κρεμάννυμι
(also κρεμαννύω, κρεμάω; the Pres. is not found in NT), [in LXX (where also κρεμάζω, Job 26:7) chiefly for תָּלָה ;] 
trans., to hang, suspend: with accusative of person(s), before ἐπὶ ξύλου, Actes 5:30 10:39; pass., Luc 23:39; before περί, Matthieu 18:6. Mid., κρέμαμαι, intrans., to hang: before ἐκ, Actes 28:4; ἐπὶ ξύλου, Galates 3:13 (LXX); metaphorically, before ἐν, Matthieu 22:40.†

G2911.def:
κρημνός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρεμάννυμι), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 25:12 (סֶלַע)* ;] 
a steep bank: Matthieu 8:32, Marc 5:13, Luc 8:33.†

G2912.def:
Κρής, ὁ, pl., Κρῆτες 
a Cretan: Actes 2:11, Tite 1:12.†

G2915.def:
κριθή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;] 
barley: pl. (as usually in cl.), Apocalypse 6:6.†

G2916.def:
κρίθινος, -η, -ον
(κριθή), [in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;] 
of barley: Jean 6:9, 13

G2917.def:
κρίμα (B1., § 27, 2), -τος, τό 
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט ;] 
the issue of a judicial process, hence, 
__1. judgment, the decision passed on the faults of others: Matthieu 7:2; in forensic sense, with genitive pun., Luc 24:20; esp. of the judgment of God, Romains 2:2 5:16 11:33 (ICC, in l), 2 Pierre 2:3, Ju 4; κ. λαμβάνεσθαι, Matthieu 23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Marc 12:40, Luc 20:47, Romains 13:2, Jacques 3:1; ἔχειν, 1 Timothée 5:12; βαστάζειν, Galates 5:10; ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, 1 Corinthiens 11:29; εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, 1 Corinthiens 11:34; εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., Luc 23:40; with genitive obj., Romains 3:8, 1 Timothée 3:6, Apocalypse 17:1; of God's judgment through Christ, Jean 9:39; τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, 1 Pierre 4:17; τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, Actes 24:25; κ. αἰώνιον, Hébreux 6:2; ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τ. κ. ὐμῶν, Apocalypse 18:20; of the right of judgment, Apocalypse 20:4. 
__2. a matter for judgment, a law-suit, a case: 1 Corinthiens 6:7.†

G2918.def:
κρίνον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן ;] 
a lily: Matthieu 6:28, Luc 12:27.†

G2919.def:
κρίνω, 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;] 
__1. to separate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: 2Ma.13:15). 
__2. to approve, esteem: Romains 14:5. 
__3. to be of opinion, judge, think: Luc 7:43, 1 Corinthiens 11:13; before τοῦτο ὅτι, 2 Corinthiens 5:14; with accusative and inf., Actes 16:15; with accusative and pred., Actes 13:46 26:8. 
__4. to decide, determine, decree: with accusative, Actes 16:4, Romains 14:13, 1 Corinthiens 7:37, 2 Corinthiens 2:1; with inf. (Field, Notes, 167), Actes 20:16 25:25, 1 Corinthiens 2:2 5:3, Tite 3:12 (cf. 1Ma.11:33, Wis.8:9, al.); with accusative and inf., Actes 21:25 27:1. 
__5. to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., Jean 8:16, 26; before κατά, with accusative, Jean 7:24 8:15; κρίσιν κ., Jean 7:24; τ. δίκαιον, Luc 12:57 (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, Jean 18:31, Actes 23:3, al.; pass., Romains 3:4 (LXX); of God's judgment, Jean 5:30 8:50, Romains 2:16 3:6, 2 Timothée 4:1, 1 Pierre 4:5, al. 
__6. = κατακρίνω, to condemn (cl.): Actes 13:27; of God's judgment, Jean 3:18 5:22 12:47, 48, Actes 7:7, Romains 2:12, 1 Corinthiens 11:32, Hébreux 10:30" (LXX), Jacques 5:9, Apocalypse 19:2, al. 
__7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), to rule, govern ( 4Ki.15:5, Psaumes 2:10, al.): Matthieu 19:28, Luc 22:30, 1 Corinthiens 6:3. 
__8. to bring to trial (cl.); mid., to go to law: with dative of person(s), Matthieu 5:40; before μετά, with genitive of person(s) (of the opponent), ἐπί, with genitive (of the judge), 1 Corinthiens 6:1, 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)).
SYN.: see: δικάστης.

G2920.def:
κρίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc. ;] 
__1. a seperating, selection (Arist., al.) 
__2. a decision, judgment (cl.): Jean 8:16, 1 Timothée 5:24, 2 Pierre 2:11, Ju 9; κ. κρίνειν, Jean 7:24; in forensic sense, Actes 8:33 (LXX) (see Page, in l); esp. of the Divine judgment, Jean 3:19 5:24, 27 5:29-30 12:31 16:8, 11, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:5, Hébreux 10:27, Jacques 2:13 5:12, 2 Pierre 2:4, Apocalypse 18:10; pl., Apocalypse 16:7 19:2; of the last judgment, Matthieu 10:15 11:22, 24 12:36, 41-42 Luc 10:14 11:31-32, Hébreux 9:27, 2 Pierre 2:9 3:7, 1 Jean 4:17, Ju 6 15; τῆς γεέννης, Matthieu 23:33. 
__3. By meton. (as in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Ésaïe 5:7, al.; דִּישׁוֹן, Daniel 7:10), of the standard of judgment, right, justice: Matthieu 12:18, 20 (LXX, Isa 42:43) Isa 23:23, Luc 11:42; of the tribunal (a local court), Matthieu 5:21-22†

G2922.def:
κριτήριον, -ου, τό
(κριτής), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:7 (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH Daniel 7:10, 26, (דִּין), Su 1:49, Exode 21:6, Juges 5:10 * ;] 
__1. a means of judging, test, criterion. 
__2. a tribunal: 1 Corinthiens 6:2 6:4, Jacques 2:6.†

G2923.def:
κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;] 
a judge: Matthieu 5:25, Luc 12:14, 58 18:2; τ. ἀδικίας, Luc 18:6; with gem of thing(s) (obj.), Actes 18:15, Jacques 4:11; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, Jacques 2:4; of a Roman procurator, Actes 24:10; of God, Hébreux 12:23, Jacques 4:12; Christ, Actes 10:42, 2 Timothée 4:8, Jacques 5:9; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, Matthieu 12:27, Luc 11:19; in the OT sense (Juges 2:16, Ruth 1:1, al), of a ruler in Israel, Actes 13:20.†
SYN.: δικάστης, q.v

G2924.def:
κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(κρίνω), 
critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., Hébreux 4:12.†

G2925.def:
Κρούω 
[in LXX: before ἐπί Juges 19:22, Cantique des cantiques 5:2 (דָּפַק) ;] 
with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, Jdth.14:14 * ;] 
to strike, knock: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), Matthieu 7:7-8, Luc 11:9-10 12:36, Actes 12:16, Apocalypse 3:20; with accusative, τ. θύραν, Luc 13:25, Actes 12:13.†

G2926.def:
κρύπτη (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ, 
a crypt, cellar: Luc 11:33.†

G2927.def:
κρυπτός, -ή, -όν
(κρύπτω) [in LXX for אָטַם, מִסְתָּר, etc. ;] 
hidden, secret: Matthieu 10:26, Marc 4:22, Luc 8:17 12:2; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, 1 Pierre 3:4; neut., ἐν τῷ κ., Matthieu 6:4, 6; ἐν κ., Jean 7:4, 10 18:20; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, Romains 2:29; pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, 1 Corinthiens 4:5; τ. ἀνθρώπων, Romains 2:16; τ. καρδίας, 1 Corinthiens 14:25; τ. αἰσχύνης, 2 Corinthiens 4:2.†
κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον 
(κρύφα = κρυφῆ) [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, Jérémie 23:24, al. ;] 
hidden, secret: ἐν τῷ κ., Matthieu 6:18.†

G2928.def:
Κρύπτω 
[in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;] 
to hide, conceal: with accusative, Matthieu 13:44 25:18; before ἐν, Matthieu 25:25 (pass., Matthieu 13:44, Colossiens 3:3); pass., Matthieu 5:14, Hébreux 11:23, 1 Timothée 5:25, Apocalypse 2:17; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν Jean 8:59; before εἰς, Luc 13:21, Apocalypse 6:15; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), Apocalypse 6:16; pass., Jean 12:36, (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaphorical: Matthieu 11:25 13:35, Luc 11:52, WH, mg., Luc 18:34 19:42, Jean 19:38 (cf.ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).†

G2929.def:
κρυσταλλίζω
(κρύσταλλος), 
to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: Apocalypse 21:11 (ἅπ, λεγ.).†

G2930.def:
κρύσταλλος, -ου, ὁ
(κρύος, frost), [in LXX: Job 38:29, Psaumes 147:17, Eze.1:22 (קֶרַח), etc. ;] 
crystal: Apocalypse 4:6 22:1.†

G2931.def:
κρυΦῇ
(prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dative; cf. εἰκῆ), 
adv., [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;] 
secretly, in secret: Éphésiens 5:12.†

G2932.def:
κτάομαι, -ῶμαι 
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָה ;] 
in pres., impf., fut. and aor., to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire (the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 10:9, Luc 18:12, Actes 8:20; with genitive pret., Actes 22:28; ἐκ with genitive pret., Actes 1:18; τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), Luc 21:19; τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:4 (where if σ. = body, κ. must = pf., κέκτημαι; see MM, xvi; M, Th., in l; Field, Notes, 72 f. But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., Notes, 53 ff.; ICC, in l).†

G2933.def:
κτῆμα, -τος, τό
(κτάομαι), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם, etc. ;] 
a possession, property: Matthieu 19:22, Marc 10:22, Actes 2:45 5:1.†

G2934.def:
κτῆνος, -ους, τό
(κτάομαι, hence primarily a possession), [in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה Genèse 1:25, al., also for מִקְנֶה, צֹנֵא, etc. ;] 
a beast, (in late Gk. esp.) a beast of burden: Luc 10:34 pl. (as chiefly in cl.), Actes 23:24, Apocalypse 18:13; of quadrupeds, as Opp. to fishes and birds (cf. Ge, l.with), 1 Corinthiens 15:39.†

G2935.def:
κτήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(κτάομαι) [in Sm.: Joël 1:11 * ;] 
a possessor: Actes 4:34.†

G2936.def:
κτίζω 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, Psaumes 51:10, al.; also for קָנָה, Genèse 14:19, Proverbes 8:22; יָצַר, Ésaïe 22:11 46:11; Wis.2:23, Sir.1:4, 9 (and freq.), I Esther 4:53, a1. ;] 
__1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with). 
__2. In LXX and NT, of God, to create: Marc 13:19, 1 Corinthiens 11:9, Colossiens 1:16 3:10 Éphésiens 3:9, 1 Timothée 4:3, Apocalypse 4:11 10:6; ὁ κτίσας, Matthieu 19:4 (WH, R, mg.), Romains 1:25; of the divine operation on the soul, Éphésiens 2:10, 15 4:24 (cf. Ps., l.with).†

G2937.def:
κτίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Psaumes 104:24 (קִנְיָן), Proverbes 1:13 A (הוֹן), Tob.8:5, Wis.2:6, Sir.16:17, 3Ma.2:2, al. ;] 
__1. a founding, settling, foundation (cl.). 
__2. In LXX and NT, 
__(a) the act of creating, creation: Marc 10:6 (Swete, in l), Marc 13:19, Romains 1:20, 2 Pierre 3:4; 
__(b) that which has been created, creation: Romains 1:25 8:39, Hébreux 4:13; καινὴ κ., 2 Corinthiens 5:17, Galates 6:15; πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κ. (Hort., in l), 1 Pierre 2:13; collectively, of the sum of created things (Wis.19:6, Jdth.16:14), Marc 16:15, Colossiens 1:15, 23 Hébreux 9:11, Apocalypse 3:14; of the irrational creation, Romains 8:19-22.†

G2938.def:
κτίσμα, -τος, τό
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Wis.9:2 13:5 14:11, Sir.36:20 (17), Sir.38:34, 3Ma.5:11 * ;] 
__1. (cl.) a colony. 
__2. a created thing, creature: 1 Timothée 4:4, Jacques 1:18, Apocalypse 5:13 8:9.†

G2939.def:
κτίστης, -oυ, ὁ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: 2 Rois 22:32 (Heb., al.), Jdth.9:12, Sir.24:8, 2 24:1-34; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;] 
__1. (cl.) a founder. 
__2. a creator: of God, 1 Pierre 4:19.†

G2940.def:
κυβία (Mt. -εία, and so Rec.), -ας, ἡ 
(κύβος, a cube, a die), 
dice-playing; metaphorically, trickery, sleight: Éphésiens 4:14.†

G2941.def:
κυβέρνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κυβερνάω, Lat. gubernare, to guide), [in LXX: Proverbes 1:5 11:14 24:6 (תַּחְבֻּלָה) * ;] 
__1. steering, pilotage (Plat.). 
__2. Metaphorical, government: pl., 1 Corinthiens 12:28.†

G2942.def:
κυβερνήτης, -ου, ὁ
(see: κυβέρνησις), [in LXX for חֹבֵל, Eze.27:8, 27-28, Proverbes 23:24, 4Ma.7:1 * ;] 
__1. a steersman, pilot: Actes 27:11, Apocalypse 18:17. 
__2. Metaphorical, a guide, governor (Eur., Plat.).†

G2943.def:
κυκλόθεν 
adv., (κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;] 
from all sides, round about: Apocalypse 4:3-4, 8,†

G2944.def:
κυκλόω, -ῶ
(κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;] 
__1. to move in a circle, revolve. 
__2. to surround, encircle: with accusative of person(s), Jean 10:24 (WH, txt., cf. -εύω), Actes 14:20; pass., Luc 21:20, Hébreux 11:30 (cf. περι-κυκλόω).†

G2945.def:
κύκλος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;] 
a ring, circle. Dat., κύκλῳ, as adverb., round about, around: Marc 3:34 6:6, 36, Luc 9:12, Romains 15:19; with genitive, Apocalypse 4:6 5:11 7:11†

G2946.def:
κύλισμα, -τος, τό
(κυλίω), [in Sm.: Eze.10:13 * ;] 
__1. a roll. 
__2. = κυλισμός (which see), a rolling, wallowing (or, as κυλίστρα, Xen., Eq., see 3, a rolling place): 2 Pierre 2:22 (Rec.).†

G2947.def:
κυλίω late form of κυλίνδω, 
[in LXX: Josué 10:18, 1 Rois 14:33, al. (גָּלַל), 4Ki.9:33 (שָׁמַט), al. ;] 
to roll, roll along. Pass., to be rolled; of persons (in Hom, as sign of grief), to roll or wallow: Marc 9:20.†

G2949.def:
κῦμα, -τος, τό
(κύω, to be pregnant, to swell) [in LXX chiefly for גַּל ;] 
a wave: pl., Matthieu 8:24 14:24, Marc 4:37; κ. θαλάσσης, figuratively, Ju 13.†
SYN.: κλύδων, q.v

G2950.def:
κύμβαλον, -ου, τό
(κύμβη, a cup), [in LXX chiefly for מְצִלָּה ;] 
a cymbal: 1 Corinthiens 13:1.†

G2951.def:
κύμινον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Ésaïe 28:25, 27 (כַּמֹּן)* ;] 
cumin: Matthieu 23:23.†

G2952.def:
κυνάριον, -ου, τό
(in Att.. also κυνίδιον, diminutive of κύων) 
a little dog: Matthieu 15:26-27 Marc 7:27-28 †

G2955.def:
κύπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַד ;] 
to bow the head, stoop down: Marc 1:7; before κάτω, Jean 8:6, 8 (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-, συν-κύπτω).†
κατα-κύπτω, 
[in LXX: 4Ki.9:32 (שָׁקַף hi.)* ;] 
to bend down, stoop: Jean 8:8 (κάτω κύψας, Rec., WH, mg.).†

G2956.def:
Κυρηναῖος, -α, -ον
(Κυρήνη), 
of Cyrene, a Cyrenæan: Matthieu 27:32, Marc 15:21, Luc 23:2, Actes 6:9 11:20 13:1.†

G2957.def:
Κυρήνη, -ης, ἡ 
Cyrene, a city in Libya: Actes 2:10.†

G2958.def:
Κυρήνιος
(prop. -ίνιος, see Bl., 13; -ῖνος L, -εῖνος, Tr., WH, mg.), -ου, ὁ, 
Quirinus, prop. Quirinius: Luc 2:2.†

G2959.def:
κυρία
(Κυρία, T, WH, mg.), -ας, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גְּבֶרֶת ;] 
a lady: 2Jn.1 Jn 5 (on the interpretation, see ICC, 167 ff.).†

G2960.def:
κυριακός, -ή, -όν
(κύριος), [in LXX: κ. φωνη (Συριακή φ., R), 2Ma.15:36 A * ;] 
__1. as frequently in Inscr. (LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 217 f.), of the lord or master, imperial. 
__2. of the Lord (i.e. Christ): δεῖπνον, 1 Corinthiens 11:20; ἡμέρα, Apocalypse 1:10. (cf. λόγια κ., Papias, Eus., HE, iii, 39, 1; γραφαὶ κ., Clem. Alex., etc; for eccl. usage, cf. Soph., Lex., see word)†

G2961.def:
κυριεύω
(κύριος), [in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁל ;] 
to be lord or master of, to rule (over): C. genitive obj., Luc 22:25, Romains 14:9, 2 Corinthiens 1:24; absol., 1 Timothée 6:15; metaphorically, ὁ θάνατος, Romains 6:9; ἡ ἁμαρτία, Romains 6:14; ὁ νόμος, Romains 7:1 (cf. κατα-κυριεύω).†

G2962G.def:
κύριος, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον), 
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for בַּעַל ,אָדוֹן, etc. ;] 
having power (κῦρος) or authority; as subst., ὁ κ., lord, master; 
__1. in general: with genitive of thing(s), Matthieu 9:38 20:8, Marc 12:9 13:35, Luc 19:33; τ. σαββάτου, Matthieu 12:8, Marc 2:28, Luc 6:5; with genitive of person(s), δούλου, etc., Matthieu 10:24, Luc 14:21, Actes 16:16, al.; absol, opposite to οἱ δοῦλοι, Éphésiens 6:5, 9 al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., LAE, 161), Actes 25:26; θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, 1 Corinthiens 8:5; of a husband, 1 Pierre 3:6; in voc, as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., Matthieu 13:27 16:22 27:63, Marc 7:28, Luc 5:12, Jean 4:11, Actes 9:5, al. 
__2. As a divine title (frequently in π.; Deiss., LAE, 353 ff.); in NT, 
__(a) of God: ὁ κ., Matthieu 5:33, Marc 5:19, Luc 1:6, Actes 7:33, Hébreux 8:2, Jacques 4:15, al.; anarth. (Bl., §46, 6), Matthieu 21:9, Marc 13:20, Luc 1:17, Hébreux 7:21, 1 Pierre 1:25, al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, Matthieu 11:25; τ. κυριευόντων, 1 Timothée 6:15; κ. ὁ θεός, Matthieu 4:7, 10 al.; id. before παντοκράτωρ, Apocalypse 4:8; κ. σαβαώθ, Romains 9:29; (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, Matthieu 1:20 2:13, Luc 1:11, al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, Luc 4:18, Actes 8:39; 
__(b) of the Christ: Matthieu 21:3, Marc 11:3, Luc 1:43 20:44, al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, Words, 330), Actes 10:36, Romains 14:8, 1 Corinthiens 7:22, Éphésiens 4:5, al.; ὁ κ. μου, Jean 20:28; ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, Actes 1:21, 1 Corinthiens 11:23, al.; id. before Χριστός, Éphésiens 1:2, al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, 1 Timothée 1:14, Hébreux 7:14, al.; id. before Ἰησοῦς, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:11, Hébreux 13:20, al.; Χριστός, Romains 16:18; Ἰ Χ., 1 Corinthiens 1:2, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:3, al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), Romains 1:4, Colossiens 2:6, Éphésiens 3:11, al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, 2 Pierre 3:2; id. before Ἰ. Χ., ib. 18; anarth., 1 Corinthiens 7:22, 25 Jacques 5:4, al.; κ. κυρίων, Apocalypse 19:16; with prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., Colossiens 3:24, al.
SYN: see: δεσπότης.

G2962H.def:
κύριος, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον), 
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for בַּעַל ,אָדוֹן, etc. ;] 
having power (κῦρος) or authority; as subst., ὁ κ., lord, master; 
__1. in general: with genitive of thing(s), Matthieu 9:38 20:8, Marc 12:9 13:35, Luc 19:33; τ. σαββάτου, Matthieu 12:8, Marc 2:28, Luc 6:5; with genitive of person(s), δούλου, etc., Matthieu 10:24, Luc 14:21, Actes 16:16, al.; absol, opposite to οἱ δοῦλοι, Éphésiens 6:5, 9 al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., LAE, 161), Actes 25:26; θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, 1 Corinthiens 8:5; of a husband, 1 Pierre 3:6; in voc, as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., Matthieu 13:27 16:22 27:63, Marc 7:28, Luc 5:12, Jean 4:11, Actes 9:5, al. 
__2. As a divine title (frequently in π.; Deiss., LAE, 353 ff.); in NT, 
__(a) of God: ὁ κ., Matthieu 5:33, Marc 5:19, Luc 1:6, Actes 7:33, Hébreux 8:2, Jacques 4:15, al.; anarth. (Bl., §46, 6), Matthieu 21:9, Marc 13:20, Luc 1:17, Hébreux 7:21, 1 Pierre 1:25, al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, Matthieu 11:25; τ. κυριευόντων, 1 Timothée 6:15; κ. ὁ θεός, Matthieu 4:7, 10 al.; id. before παντοκράτωρ, Apocalypse 4:8; κ. σαβαώθ, Romains 9:29; (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, Matthieu 1:20 2:13, Luc 1:11, al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, Luc 4:18, Actes 8:39; 
__(b) of the Christ: Matthieu 21:3, Marc 11:3, Luc 1:43 20:44, al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, Words, 330), Actes 10:36, Romains 14:8, 1 Corinthiens 7:22, Éphésiens 4:5, al.; ὁ κ. μου, Jean 20:28; ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, Actes 1:21, 1 Corinthiens 11:23, al.; id. before Χριστός, Éphésiens 1:2, al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, 1 Timothée 1:14, Hébreux 7:14, al.; id. before Ἰησοῦς, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:11, Hébreux 13:20, al.; Χριστός, Romains 16:18; Ἰ Χ., 1 Corinthiens 1:2, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:3, al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), Romains 1:4, Colossiens 2:6, Éphésiens 3:11, al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, 2 Pierre 3:2; id. before Ἰ. Χ., ib. 18; anarth., 1 Corinthiens 7:22, 25 Jacques 5:4, al.; κ. κυρίων, Apocalypse 19:16; with prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., Colossiens 3:24, al.
SYN: see: δεσπότης.

G2963.def:
κυριότης, -ητος, ἡ
(κύριος), 
lordship, dominion: Éphésiens 1:21, 2 Pierre 2:10, Ju 8; pl., Colossiens 1:16 (cf. Lft., Col; Mayor, Ju., in ll.; DB, i, 616 f.).†

G2964.def:
κυρόω, -ῶ
(κῦρος, 1. authority. 2. validity), [in LXX for קוּם ;] 
to confirm, ratify, make valid: 2 Corinthiens 2:8; pass., Galates 3:15 (cf. προ-κυρόω).†

G2965.def:
κύων, κυνός, ὁ, ἡ
(in NT masc. only), [in LXX forכֶּלֶב ;] 
a dog: Luc 16:21, 2 Pierre 2:22; metaphorically, as a word of reproach, Matthieu 7:6, Philippiens 3:2, Apocalypse 22:15.†

G2966.def:
κῶλον, -ου, τό 
a limb, member of a body, 
[but in LXX (Lévitique 26:30, Nombres 14:29, 32-33, 1 Rois 17:46, Ésaïe 66:24*) for פֶּגֶר ;] 
hence, carcase: Hébreux 3:17 (LXX).†

G2967.def:
κωλύω
(κόλος), [in LXX for כָּלָא, מָנַע, etc. ;] 
to hinder, re­strain, forbid, withhold: with accusative and inf., Matthieu 19:14, Luc 23:2, Actes 8:36 16:6 24:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:16, Hébreux 7:23; inf. om., Marc 9:38-39 10:14, Luc 9:49-50 11:52 18:16, Actes 11:17, Romains 1:13, 3Jn.10; accusative om., 1 Timothée 4:3; with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), Actes 27:43; with accusative of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 14:39, 2 Pierre 2:16; id. before τοῦ μή, Actes 10:47; id. before ἀπό (like Heb. מִן כָּלָא, Genèse 23:6, al.), Luc 6:29 (cf. δια-κωλύω).†

G2968.def:
κώμη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX for בַּת, חָצֵר, עִיר, etc. ;] 
a village or country town, prop, as opposite to a walled city: Matthieu 14:15, Marc 6:6, al.; πόλεις καὶ κ., Matthieu 9:35, al.; with the name added, Βηθλεέμ, Jean 7:42; Βηθανΐα, Jean 11:1; with the name of the district, τὰς κ. Καισαρίας, Marc 8:27; Σαμαρειτῶν, Luc 9:52, Actes 8:25

G2969.def:
κωμόπολις, -εως, ἡ 
a country town: Marc 1:38 (see Swete, in l).†

G2970.def:
κῶμος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Wis.14:23, 2Ma.6:4 * ;] 
a revel, carousal: Romains 13:13, Galates 5:21, 1 Pierre 4:3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη

G2971.def: a gnat, mosquito , Lat. culex, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G2972.def:
Κῶς genitive Κῶ, ἡ, 
Cos, an island in the Ægean Sea: accusative Κῶ, Actes 21:1 (Κῶν, Rec.).†

G2974.def:
κωφός, -ή, -όν
(κόπτω), [in LXX chiefly (Exode 4:11, al.) for אִלֵּם; for חָרָשׁ, Habacuc 2:18 ;] 
blunt, dull. Metaphorical, of the senses, esp. 
__(a) of speech, dumb: Matthieu 9:32-33 12:22 15:30-31, Luc 1:22 11:14; 
__(b) of hearing, deaf: Matthieu 11:5, Marc 7:32, 37 9:25, Luc 7:22.†

G2975.def:
λαγχάνω 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 14:47 (לָכַד, see Th., Gr., 38), Wis.8:19, 3Mac 61 * ;] 
__1. to obtain by lot, to obtain (in cl., with genitive): with inf. art. (B1., § 36, 3; 71, 3), Luc 1:9; with accusative of thing(s), Actes 1:17, 2 Pierre 1:1. 
__2. to draw lots: before περί, Jean 19:24

G2976G.def:
Λάζαρος, -ου, ὁ 
colloquial abbreviation of Ἐλεαζάρ (άζαρος), which see), 
Lazarus; 
__1. of Bethany: Jean 11:1 ff. Jean 12:1-2, 9-10 12:17. 
__2. The beggar in the parable: Luc 16:20, 23-25.†

G2976H.def:
Λάζαρος, -ου, ὁ 
colloquial abbreviation of Ἐλεαζάρ (άζαρος), which see), 
Lazarus; 
__1. of Bethany: Jean 11:1 ff. Jean 12:1-2, 9-10 12:17. 
__2. The beggar in the parable: Luc 16:20, 23-25.†

G2977.def:
λάθρᾳ (Att..; in Hom., -ρῃ, Rec. -ρα), 
adv., [in LXX chiefly for ‎סֵתֶר ;] 
secretly: Matthieu 1:19 2:7, Marc 5:33 (WH, mg.), Jean 11:28, Actes 16:37.†

G2978.def:
λαῖλαψ, -απος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Job 21:18 27:20 א (סוּפָה) Job 38:1, Jérémie 25:32 (סַעַר), Wis.5:14, 23, Sir.48:9, 12 * ;] 
a hurricane, whirlwind: Marc 4:37, Luc 8:23, 2 Pierre 2:17.†
SYN.: θύελλα, which see, and cf. ἄνεμος

G2979.def:
λακτίζω
(λάξ, with the foot), 
to kick: Actes 26:14.†

G2980.def:
λαλέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for דּבר pi., also for אמר, etc. ;] 
__1. to utter: of inanimate things, Apocalypse 4:1 10:4; metaphorically, Hébreux 11:4 12:24. 
__2. to talk, speak, say: absol., Matthieu 9:33 12:46, Marc 5:35, Luc 8:49; before ὡς, 1 Corinthiens 13:11, Apocalypse 13:11; εἰς, 1 Corinthiens 14:9; ἐκ, Matthieu 12:34; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 10:19, Marc 11:32, Jean 8:30, al.; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 12:46, Luc 24:6, Romains 7:1, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Matthieu 9:18, Jean 10:6, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, Marc 6:50, Luc 1:19 2:33, al.; ἐν, ἐξ, ἀπό, Matthieu 13:3, Jean 12:49 14:10, al.; λ. τ. λόγον, Marc 8:32, al.; before orat. dir. (not cl.), Marc 14:31, Hébreux 5:5 11:18; Hebraistically (Dalman, Words, 25f.), ἐλάλησε λέγων, Matthieu 14:27, Jean 8:12, Actes 8:26, al. 
SYN.: see: λέγω.

G2981.def:
λαλία, -ᾶς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, דִּבְרָה ;] 
__1. loquacity = Very talkative. 
__2. talk, speech, conversation: Matthieu 26:73 (cf. Ca 43), Jean 4:42 8:43.†

G2982.def:
λαμά (Heb. מָה, seel. λεμά = Aram. לְמָא) 
why: Matthieu 27:46 (WH, mg., λεμά TTr., WH, txt., λεμά L), Marc 15:34 (λεμά LT, λαμμᾶ, Rec.).†

G2983.def:
λαμβάνω, 
[in LXX chiefly for לקח, also for אחז ,לכד ,נשׂא, etc. ;] 
__1. to take, lay hold of: absol., Matthieu 26:26, Marc 14:22; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 5:40 26:52, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 21:35, Marc 12:3, al.; pleonastic λαβών (M, Pr., 230; Bl., §74, 2), Matthieu 13:31 14:19, al.; so also indic., Marc 7:27, Jean 19:1, 40 Apocalypse 8:5, al.; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), ἀφορμήν, Romains 7:8, 11; ὑδόδειγμα, Jacques 5:10; id. with accusative of person(s), φόβος, Luc 7:16; πνεῦμα, Luc 9:39; πειρασμός, 1 Corinthiens 10:13; aoristic pf. (M, Pr., 145, 238; BL, §59, 4), Apocalypse 5:7 8:5, al. 
__2. to receive: absol., opposite to αἰτεῖν, Matthieu 7:8, al.; διδόναι, Matthieu 10:8, Actes 20:35; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 27:6, Marc 10:3o, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), Jean 6:21 13:20 19:27, 2Jo.10; ῥαπίσμασιν (a vulgarism; Bl., §38, 3), Marc 14:65; metaphorically, τ. λόγον, Matthieu 13:20, Marc 4:16; τ. μαρτυρίαν, Jean 3:11; τ. ῥήματα, Jean 12:48; πρόσωπον (Heb. נָשָׂא פָּנִים, Dalman, Words, 30), Luc 20:21, Galates 2:6; ζωὴν αἰώνιον (Dalman, op. cit., 124f.), Marc 10:30 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, συν-αντι- (-μαι), ἀπο-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, συν-περι-, ὑπο-λαμβάνω).

G2984.def:
Λάμεχ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. לֶמֶךְ), 
Lamech (Genèse 5:25): Luc 3:36.†

G2985.def:
λαμπάς, -άδος, ἡ
(λάμπω), [in LXX for לַפִּיד ;] 
a torch (frequently fed, like a lamp, with oil): Matthieu 25:1 ff., Jean 18:3, Actes 20:8, Apocalypse 4:5 8:10.†

G2986.def:
λαμπρός, -ά, -όν
(λάμπω), [in LXX: Tob.13:11, Wis.6:12 17:20, Sir.29:22 33:13 (Sir.30:25) Sir.31:23, Ep. Je 60 * ;] 
bright, brilliant: ποταμός, Apocalypse 22:1 (ΕΥ, clear); ἀστήρ, Apocalypse 22:16; of clothing, brilliant, splendid: Luc 23:11, Actes 10:30, Jacques 2:2-3, Apocalypse 15:6 18:14 19:8.†

G2987.def:
λαμπρότης, -ητος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Psaumes 110:3 (הָדָר), al. ;] 
brightness, brilliancy: τ. ἡλίου, Actes 26:13.†

G2988.def:
λαμπρῶς 
adv., 
splendidly: of sumptuous fare (as freq.; cf. ἐδέσματα λαμπρά, Sir.29:22), Luc 16:19.†

G2989.def:
λάμπω 
[in LXX for נָגַהּ, etc. ;] 
to shine: Matthieu 5:15-16 17:2, Luc 17:24, Actes 12:7, 2 Corinthiens 4:6 (cf. ἐκ-, περι-λάμπω).†

G2990.def:
λανθάνω 
[in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc. ;] 
to escape notice, be hidden (from): Marc 7:24, Luc 8:47; with accusative of person(s), Actes 26:26, 2 Pierre 3:5 3:8; as in common cl. idiom, before ptcp., ἔλαθον ξενίσαντες, entertained unawares, Hébreux 13:2 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-λανθάνω).†

G2991.def:
λαξευτός, -ή, όν
(λαξεύω; λᾶς, a stone, ξέω, to scrape), [in LXX: Deutéronome 4:49 (פִּסְגָּה); in Aq.: Nombres 21:20; Th.: Juges 7:11 * ;] 
hewn (in stone); Luc 23:53 (elsewhere κοινή writers use λατομητός, 4Ki.12:12, al.; cf. λατομέω).†

G2992.def:
λαός, -οῦ, ὁ, 
[in LXX very frequently for עַם, Genèse 14:16, al.; occasionally for לְאֹם ( Genèse 25:23, al.), etc. ;] 
a word rarely found in Att. prose; 
__1. the people at large (Hom., al.), esp. of people assembled: Matthieu 27:25, Luc 1:21 3:15 al.; pl. (Hom., al., π.; see MM, xvi), Actes 4:27. 
__2. a people, those of the same race and language (Pind., Æsch., al.: in LXX, Genèse 26:11, Exode 9:16, al.): joined with γλῶσσα, φυλή, ἔθνος, Apocalypse 5:9 7:9 11:9, al.; pl., Luc 2:31, Romains 15:11; esp. as almost always in LXX, of Israel, Matthieu 4:23, Marc 7:6, Luc 2:10, Jean 11:50, Hébreux 2:17, al.; opposite to τ. ἔθνη, Actes 26:17, 23 Romains 15:10; πρεσβύτεροι (πρῶτοι, etc.) τοῦ λ., Matthieu 21:23, Luc 19:17, Actes 4:8, al.; ὁ λ. μου (αὐτοῦ, τ. θεοῦ), Matthieu 2:6, Luc 1:68, Hébreux 11:25, al.; of the people disting. from the rulers and priests ( I Esther 1:10, Jdth.8:9, al.), Matthieu 26:5, Luc 20:19, Hébreux 5:3, al.; of Christians, as the people of God, Actes 15:14, Romains 9:25, 26 Hébreux 4:9; περιούσιος, Tite 2:14; εἰς περιποίησιν, 1 Pierre 2:9 (LXX). 
SYN.: see: δῆμος.

G2993.def:
Λαοδικία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ 
Laodicea, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: Colossiens 2:1 4:13, 15-16, Apocalypse 1:11 3:14.†

G2995.def:
λάρυγξ, -γγος, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for חֵךְ, Job 6:30, al; Psaumes 5:9 (גָּרוֹן) ;] 
the larynx, throat: metaphorically, of speech (cf. Sir.6:5), Romains 3:13" (LXX) .†

G2996.def:
Λασέα (Rec. -αία), -ας, ἡ 
Lasea, a city of Crete, otherwise un­known: Actes 27:8.†

G2997.def:
λάσκω 
__1. (in cl., poët.) to clang, crash, crack; in late prose, to crack or burst noisily: Actes 1:18 (ἐλάκησεν, perh., however, from λακέω, which see; Bl., in l). 
__2. (in cl., prose) to scream, shout.†
λακέω, Dor. for ληκέω = λάσκω, q.v

G2998.def:
λατομέω, -ῶ
(λατόμος, a stonecutter, 4Ki.12:12, al.; λᾶς, τέμνω; cf. λαξευτός) [in LXX: 1 Chroniques 22:2, al. (חָצַב); Exode 21:33, Num_21:18 (כָּרָה) ;] 
to hew, hew out stones: Matthieu 27:60, Marc 15:46.†

G2999.def:
λατρεία, -ας, ἡ
(λατρεύω, which see), [in LXX (always of divine service): Exode 12:25-26 13:5, Josué 22:27, 1 Chroniques 28:13 (עֲבֹדָה), 1Ma.1:43 1Mac 2:19 1Mac 2:22, 3Ma.4:14 * ;] 
__1. hired service, service. 
__2. (in cl. also) divine service, worship: Jean 16:2, Romains 9:4 12:1, Hébreux 9:1, 6.†
